title: Fix Board Canvas Interaction Regression
description: Investigate regression where semio board canvas became effectively read-only after commit 435 (434 reportedly worked). UI chrome and tools still render, but selecting, zooming, panning, and related canvas interactions no longer work. Need root-cause fix, validation, and thorough ticket documentation of hypotheses tried so future attempts do not repeat dead ends. Focus on semio board/sketchpad only.
summary: Fixed board canvas interaction regression by correcting the event-surface DOM target guard in elements/client/lib/board/index.ts. The window-capture pointer bridge was rejecting all canvas events because the module-local board Node class shadowed the DOM Node constructor in eventTargetIsUnderEventSurface(). Replaced that guard with a DOM-safe constructor lookup plus composedPath handling, added a regression test for the shadowing case, and documented the full investigation, hypotheses, and validation blocker in the ticket notes. Validation: changed file has no compile errors via get_errors; direct Vitest execution is currently blocked by an existing missing vitest project config path in the repo.
